info.title: Peacock Academy API
info.description: Contract for the Peacock Academy school management system. Every response uses the standard envelope; the frontend switches on error.code, never on message.

post.summary: Create a admin account with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a admin (soft delete). Ends all their logins

post.summary: Change own password. Ends all other logins and starts a fresh one. Allowed while a change is required.
Email a single-use reset link. Always answers 200, whether or not the account exists.
Log in with email, phone, staff ID or registration number. Sets the cookies; no token is returned.
End this login
End every login this user has
Swap the refresh cookie for new cookies. 409 CONFLICT means retry once.
Set a new password with the link from the email. Ends every login. VALIDATION_ERROR on field "token" means the link is invalid or used.

get.summary: List class arms, optionally for one class

post.summary: Create an arm, for example JSS1 A

put.summary: Set the class teacher of an arm. Replaces the previous one

post.summary: Create a class and choose its subjects

patch.summary: Change a class name, level or subject list

get.summary: List parent-student links. Filter status=PENDING to see claims waiting for approval

patch.summary: Approve a pending claim (ACTIVE) or revoke a link (REVOKED)

post.summary: Claim a child with a code from the school. Pending until an admin approves
Create a parent account (phone, email or both) with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a parent (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One parent (a parent sees only themselves)

patch.summary: Update a parent. A parent may change only their own address and phone

post.summary: Link a parent to a student. Active at once

get.summary: Readiness: MongoDB and Redis both answer

post.summary: Create a session, for example 2026/2027

patch.summary: Change a session name or dates

get.summary: List students. Teachers see only the classes they teach

post.summary: Admit a student. Returns the registration number and a one-time temporary password

delete.summary: Remove a student (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One student (a parent sees only their children, a student only themselves)

post.summary: Make a one-time claim code for a student, to give to a parent. Shown once, valid 14 days

put.summary: Put a student in a class for a session (defaults to the current one)

post.summary: Upload a CSV (field "file", max 2 MB, 1000 rows). Validates every row and returns a report; nothing is saved
Save a clean import. Returns each new registration number and one-time password
Create a subject

patch.summary: Change a subject name or code

post.summary: Create a teacher account with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a teacher (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One teacher (a teacher sees only themselves)

patch.summary: Update a teacher. A teacher may change only their own address and phone

get.summary: List assignments. A teacher sees only their own

post.summary: Give a teacher a subject in a class arm. The class must offer the subject. Defaults to the current session

patch.summary: Hand an assignment to another teacher

get.summary: List terms, filter by session or current

post.summary: Create a term inside a session

patch.summary: Change a term name or dates (not while closed)

post.summary: Close a term. Its details can no longer be edited
Reopen a closed term
Make this term, and its session, the current one
End every login this user has right now
Lock an account and end all its logins. Admins can only act on non-admin accounts

get.summary: Sign-in activity for an account, newest first

post.summary: Set a new temporary password, shown once. Ends all logins and forces a change
Unlock an account (also clears a login-attempt lockout)
